title: ベンチと手すり付き公園回転遊具
titleEn: Playground roundabout with seats and rails
description: 公園の遊び場に配置する、円形デッキと固定ベンチを備えた回転遊具の静的モデル。縁枠と滑り止め風の桟、三つの湾曲座面、中央の環状グリップと外側手すり、足元金具、下面の放射状補強、軸受風ハブと接地プレートを造形。全体で1点です。回転・衝突判定はなく、実用品の安全性・耐荷重・規格適合は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.130 × 0.947 × 2.130 m、22,344三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static roundabout assembly for playground scenes, with a circular deck and three fixed curved benches. It has a rim, raised grip-looking strips, central ring grip and outer rails, foot sockets, radial underside stiffeners, bearing-looking hub and grounded anchor plate. The whole assembly counts as one model. Rotation and collision behavior are absent; real-equipment safety, load capacity and standards compliance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.130 × 0.947 × 2.130 m; 22,344 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
